project_id.description: Project this run was performed against

result.description: Outcome of the run. 'escalated' = operator took over after agent was blocked.

summary.description: Human-readable summary of what was accomplished

eval_failures.description: List of eval test names that failed (e.g., 'test_mining.py::TestZeroKnownFailures::test_scue_tests_all_pass'). Used for flakiness analysis across runs.

backfilled.description: Whether this record was retroactively created

time_to_operator_response.description: Minutes from first operator-gated checkpoint (spec approval, plan approval, AskUserQuestion) to operator response. Null if no checkpoint occurred. Populate at task close by checking session timestamps.

operator_interventions.description: DEPRECATED — use human_touches.corrections. Number of operator interventions.

agent_escalations.description: DEPRECATED — use human_touches.escalations. Number of agent escalations.

human_touches.description: Structured count of all human interactions during this run. The total is the key automation-effectiveness metric: lower = more autonomous.

questions.description: Questions asked by agent (AskUserQuestion, decision queue)

corrections.description: Operator redirections, scope changes, or 'no, do X instead'

escalations.description: Agent escalated to operator (blocked, incident, uncertainty)

approvals.description: Gated checkpoints requiring operator sign-off (spec, plan, PR)

total.description: Sum of all above. The headline metric for pipeline comparison.
